correctness.rationale: A basis polytope edge is a single-element exchange, so shortest length-three paths in the hypersimplex are independent deletion/insertion permutations (3!)²=36 through 18 internal Johnson interval vertices. Each internal vertex lies on exactly four paths. Forbidden rank-k sets form a Johnson independent set, hence no path contains two, so g=36-4s. Independently constructed the two 3x3 rook layers and cross-board adjacency, enumerated all 2^18 candidate nonbase subsets; exactly 202 are stable, with s multiplicities 1,18,81,84,18, and independent path enumeration yields all five g-values. Four-forbidden patterns are exactly 18 crossed rectangles. Global realization uses the basis-exchange fact for stable forbidden k-subsets, which holds for all 3<=k<=n-3 rather than being inferred from J(6,3) alone. No claim for higher exchange distance.
